                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{2(\\sec^2A)}{5(cosec^2A)}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{2}{5}\\tan^2A\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ \\(\\dfrac{20 + 20 \\tan^2A}{50 + 50 \\cot^2A}\\) = \\(\\dfrac{2}{5}\\tan^2A\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\dfrac{20 + 20 \\tan^2A}{50 + 50 \\cot^2A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\( \\dfrac{sec^2}{cosec^2} \\) = tan2 A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\dfrac{20 + 20 \\tan^2A}{50 + 50 \\cot^2A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\( \\dfrac{sec^2}{cosec^2} \\) = tan2 A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    tan2 A + 1 = secदिलेल्याप्रमाणे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\dfrac{20 + 20 \\tan^2A}{50 + 50 \\cot^2A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\( \\dfrac{sec^2}{cosec^2} \\) = tan2 A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\", "bn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "ml": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "gu": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "ta": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{20 + 20 \\tan^2A}{50 + 50 \\cot^2A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{2(1 + \\tan^2A)}{5(1 + \\cot^2A)}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{2(\\sec^2A)}{5(cosec^2A)}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{2}{5}\\tan^2A\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ \\(\\dfrac{20 + 20 \\tan^2A}{50 + 50 \\cot^2A}\\) = \\(\\dfrac{2}{5}\\tan^2A\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\dfrac{20 + 20 \\tan^2A}{50 + 50 \\cot^2A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੰਕਲਪ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\( \\dfrac{sec^2}{cosec^2} \\) = tan2 A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    tan2 A + 1 = sec2 A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    cot2 A + 1 = cosec2 A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ਗਣਨਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{20 + 20 \\tan^2A}{50 + 50 \\cot^2A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{2(1 + \\tan^2A)}{5(1 + \\cot^2A)}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{2(\\sec^2A)}{5(cosec^2A)}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{2}{5}\\tan^2A\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ \\(\\dfrac{20 + 20 \\tan^2A}{50 + 50 \\cot^2A}\\) = \\(\\dfrac{2}{5}\\tan^2A\\)
