                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (1) To take advantage of the provisions of this Part, any association or group of Indian nationals identifying themselves as political parties must apply to the Election Commission for registration as such for the purposes of this Act.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (2) Each such application must be submitted,—(a) if the association or body was already in existence at the time the Representation of the People (Amendment) Act, 1988 (1 of 1989) went into effect, within sixty days after that date; (b) if the association or body was created after that date, within thirty days after that date.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (3) The top executive officer of the association or body, whether referred to as the Secretary or by any other title, must sign each application made pursuant to subsection (1) and present it in person or send it by registered mail to the Secretary of the Commission.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (4) Each of these applications must include the information listed below: (a) the name of the organisation or body; the name of its president, secretary, treasurer, and other office-holders; (b) the State in which its head office is located; (c) the address to which letters and other communications meant for it should be sent; (d) the number of its members, and if there are categories of its members, the number of members in each category; (f) whether it has any local units; if so, at what levels;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t(g) whether it is represented by any member or members in either House of Parliament or of any State Legislature; if so, the number of such member or members.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (5) The application under subsection (1) shall be accompanied by a copy of the memorandum or rules and regulations of the association or body, by whatever name called, and such memorandum or rules and regulations shall specifically state that the association or body shall bear true faith and allegiance to the Constitution of India as established by law, to the principles of socialism, secularism, and democracy, and would uphold the sovereignty, unity, and inviolability of the country.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (6) The Commission may request from the association or entity any additional information it deems appropriate. 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (7) The Commission shall decide whether to register the association or body as a political party for the purposes of this Part after taking into account all the aforementioned details in its possession and any other necessary and relevant factors, and after affording the representatives of the association or body a reasonable opportunity to be heard. The Commission shall communicate its decision to the association or body (5).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (8) The Commission's judgement is conclusive.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (9) Following the registration of an organisation or body as a political party as aforesaid, any change in its name, head office, office-bearers, address or in any other material matters shall be communicated to the Commission without delay.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

"correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The correct answer is Registration of Political Parties.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                •  Section 29A- Registration of organisations and groups as political parties with the Election Commission (29A).\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (1) To take advantage of the provisions of this Part, any association or group of Indian nationals identifying themselves as political parties must apply to the Election Commission for registration as such for the purposes of this Act.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (2) Each such application must be submitted,—(a) if the association or body was already in existence at the time the Representation of the People (Amendment) Act, 1988 (1 of 1989) went into effect, within sixty days after that date; (b) if the association or body was created after that date, within thirty days after that date.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (3) The top executive officer of the association or body, whether referred to as the Secretary or by any other title, must sign each application made pursuant to subsection (1) and present it in person or send it by registered mail to the Secretary of the Commission.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (4) Each of these applications must include the information listed below: (a) the name of the organisation or body; the name of its president, secretary, treasurer, and other office-holders; (b) the State in which its head office is located; (c) the address to which letters and other communications meant for it should be sent; (d) the number of its members, and if there are categories of its members, the number of members in each category; (f) whether it has any local units; if so, at what levels;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t(g) whether it is represented by any member or members in either House of Parliament or of any State Legislature; if so, the number of such member or members.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (5) The application under subsection (1) shall be accompanied by a copy of the memorandum or rules and regulations of the association or body, by whatever name called, and such memorandum or rules and regulations shall specifically state that the association or body shall bear true faith and allegiance to the Constitution of India as established by law, to the principles of socialism, secularism, and democracy, and would uphold the sovereignty, unity, and inviolability of the country.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (6) The Commission may request from the association or entity any additional information it deems appropriate. 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (7) The Commission shall decide whether to register the association or body as a political party for the purposes of this Part after taking into account all the aforementioned details in its possession and any other necessary and relevant factors, and after affording the representatives of the association or body a reasonable opportunity to be heard. The Commission shall communicate its decision to the association or body (5).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (8) The Commission's judgement is conclusive.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (9) Following the registration of an organisation or body as a political party as aforesaid, any change in its name, head office, office-bearers, address or in any other material matters shall be communicated to the Commission without delay.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Can the Election Commission deregister political parties?\n\n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The Constitution or the undertaking made to it at the time of registration cannot be used as grounds for the ECI to deregister parties. A party may only be declared unlawful by the Central Government, if its registration was gained fraudulently, if it alters its internal constitution and notifies the ECI that it can no longer adhere to the Indian Constitution, or if it was fraudulently registered.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                सही उत्तर राजनीतिक दलों का पंजीकरण है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • धारा 29A- चुनाव आयोग में राजनीतिक दलों के रूप में संगठनों और समूहों का पंजीकरण (29A)।\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • (1) इस भाग के प्रावधानों का लाभ उठाने के लिए, भारतीय नागरिकों के किसी भी संघ या समूह को खुद को राजनीतिक दलों के रूप में पहचानने के लिए इस अधिनियम के प्रयोजनों के लिए पंजीकरण के लिए चुनाव आयोग को आवेदन करना होगा।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • (2) इस तरह के प्रत्येक आवेदन को प्रस्तुत किया जाना चाहिए, - (A) यदि संघ या निकाय पहले से ही अस्तित्व में था, जब लोक प्रतिनिधित्व (संशोधन) अधिनियम, 1988 (1989 का 1) प्रभाव में आया, उसके बाद साठ दिनों के भीतर उस तारीख; (B) यदि संघ या निकाय उस तिथि के बाद बनाया गया था, तो उस तिथि के तीस दिनों के भीतर।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • (3) संघ या निकाय के शीर्ष कार्यकारी अधिकारी, चाहे सचिव के रूप में संदर्भित हों या किसी अन्य शीर्षक से, उपधारा (1) के अनुसार किए गए प्रत्येक आवेदन पर हस्ताक्षर करना चाहिए और इसे व्यक्तिगत रूप से प्रस्तुत करना चाहिए या आयोग के सचिव को पंजीकृत डाक द्वारा भेजना चाहिए। .
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • (4) इनमें से प्रत्येक आवेदन में नीचे सूचीबद्ध जानकारी शामिल होनी चाहिए: (a) संगठन या निकाय का नाम; इसके अध्यक्ष, सचिव, कोषाध्यक्ष और अन्य कार्यालय-धारकों का नाम; (b) वह राज्य जिसमें इसका प्रधान कार्यालय स्थित है; (c) वह पता जिस पर इसके लिए पत्र और अन्य संचार भेजे जाने चाहिए; (d) इसके सदस्यों की संख्या, और यदि इसके सदस्यों की श्रेणियां हैं, तो प्रत्येक श्रेणी में सदस्यों की संख्या; (f) क्या इसकी कोई स्थानीय इकाई है; यदि हां, तो किस स्तर पर; (g) क्या इसका प्रतिनिधित्व संसद के किसी सदन या किसी राज्य विधानमंडल के किसी सदस्य या सदस्यों द्वारा किया जाता है; यदि हां, तो ऐसे सदस्य या सदस्यों की संख्या।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • (5) उप-धारा (1) के तहत आवेदन ज्ञापन या संघ या निकाय के नियमों और विनियमों की एक प्रति के साथ होगा, जिसे किसी भी नाम से जाना जाता है, और इस तरह के ज्ञापन या नियमों और विनियमों में विशेष रूप से कहा जाएगा कि संघ या निकाय समाजवाद, धर्मनिरपेक्षता और लोकतंत्र के सिद्धांतों के लिए कानून द्वारा स्थापित भारत के संविधान के प्रति सच्ची आस्था और निष्ठा रखते हैं, और देश की संप्रभुता, एकता और हिंसा को बनाए रखेंगे।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • (6) आयोग संघ या इकाई से किसी भी अतिरिक्त जानकारी का अनुरोध कर सकता है जिसे वह उचित समझे।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • (7) आयोग इस भाग के प्रयोजनों के लिए एसोसिएशन या निकाय को एक राजनीतिक दल के रूप में पंजीकृत करने का फैसला करेगा या नहीं, उपरोक्त सभी विवरणों को ध्यान में रखते हुए और किसी भी अन्य आवश्यक और प्रासंगिक कारकों को ध्यान में रखते हुए, और प्रतिनिधियों को प्रदान करने के बाद संघ या निकाय को सुनवाई का एक उचित अवसर। आयोग अपने निर्णय को संघ या निकाय (5) को सूचित करेगा।
